n63807c425ff.s: Over-urbanisation refers to a situation in which urban population growth:
o: Lags behind the growth of urban jobs and services
Is slower than rural population growth
Outpaces the growth of urban jobs and services
Matches the expansion of urban employment and services
n63807c425ff.x: Over-urbanisation occurs when urban population growth outpaces jobs and services, often resulting in slums.

n9d35c1da97e.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025–26, a doubling of the dependency ratio will make which of the following a growth job sector?
n9d35c1da97e.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 notes that a doubling of the dependency ratio will make geriatric care a growth-oriented employment sector.

n9aa46766f24.s: India's demographic dividend window is expected to close after ____, making skilling and job creation time-bound priorities.
n9aa46766f24.x: The demographic dividend window is expected to close after 2041; hence skilling and creation of suitable jobs are time-bound priorities.

n516263de81d.s: As per UN World Population Prospects 2022, world population is projected to reach 9.7 billion in:
n516263de81d.x: WPP 2022 projected 8.5 billion in 2030, 9.7 billion in 2050 and 10.4 billion in 2100.

n3530d94c7c8.s: Which group consists of the most urbanised regions of the world?
o: Northern America, Latin America and Europe
n3530d94c7c8.x: Northern America, Latin America and Europe are among the most urbanised regions, whereas Africa and Asia are seeing the fastest urban growth.

nb77a7f36093.s: Other factors remaining constant, which combination raises the population density of a region?
nb77a7f36093.x: Natality adds people through natural increase and immigration adds people from outside; mortality and emigration reduce density.

n169b7fd38b6.s: Which region has very high population density owing to fertile alluvial soils, water and intensive agriculture?
n169b7fd38b6.x: The Ganga plain and the Ganges–Brahmaputra delta are among the world's densely populated regions, supported by fertile alluvium, water and intensive agriculture.

n41e12114929.s: Dhanbad is the most densely inhabited district of the Chotanagpur Plateau mainly because of:
n41e12114929.x: Dhanbad's high density is associated with coal mining, industrialisation and related employment; BCCL is based there.

n37b59fb8876.s: Which of the following is an exception to the sparse population of mountainous terrain?
o: Valleys such as Kashmir and parts of Himachal Pradesh
n37b59fb8876.x: Although the Himalayas are generally sparsely populated, valleys such as Kashmir and parts of Himachal Pradesh have relatively high density.

n71791a67377.s: Who coined the term 'BIMARU' in the mid-1980s?
n71791a67377.x: Demographer Ashish Bose coined the term BIMARU in the mid-1980s.

ncac099b5981.s: In 2011, Bihar ranked third among States in population but ____ in area.
ncac099b5981.x: Bihar was third in population but twelfth in area, a contrast that contributes to its high population density.

nc95f46eca87.s: Because the 2021 Census was delayed, Census 2027 will be held how many years after Census 2011?
nc95f46eca87.x: The 2021 Census was delayed, making Census 2027 the next Census, 16 years after Census 2011.

n5585b513c93.s: The Census of India is conducted by the:
o: Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs
n5585b513c93.x: The Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, conducts the Census.

nb36af3ce4e1.s: Which of the following pairs (population density, Census 2011, persons per sq km) is correctly matched?
nb36af3ce4e1.x: Arunachal Pradesh had 17 persons per sq km; Bihar had 1,106, West Bengal 1,028 and Kerala 860.

n046ccf58986.s: The main concern of southern States about delimitation after Census 2027 is that:
o: Their seat share may rise because of faster population growth
Their seat share may decline because they controlled population growth
Delimitation will be based on area instead of population
Their seat share will be frozen at 1971 levels permanently
n046ccf58986.x: Southern States, including Andhra Pradesh, fear a fall in seat share because population-based delimitation may penalise States that controlled population growth.

nap-geography-17-2.s: Which of the following about Andhra Pradesh (Census 2011) is INCORRECT?
o: Its share of India's population was 4.10%.
Its sex ratio was 997 females per 1,000 males.
It was the 10th largest State by population.
nap-geography-17-2.x: AP's 2011 literacy was 67.35%; 72.98% is the all-India rate. The other three statements are correct.

nec4c8dd7318.s: On the 28-district map of Andhra Pradesh, which district has the highest population density (1,870 per sq km)?
nec4c8dd7318.x: Visakhapatnam has the highest density at 1,870 per sq km, while Polavaram has the lowest at 54.

n51030b3ac0c.s: Which demographic feature characterised the British period in India?
o: Low birth rate and low death rate
Falling birth rate and low death rate
High birth rate and falling death rate with rapid growth
High birth and death rates with famines and epidemics
n51030b3ac0c.x: The British period was marked by high birth and death rates, frequent famines and epidemics.

ne64a24ac0dc.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Formal three-stage transition theory – Warren Thompson
ne64a24ac0dc.x: Edwin Cannan is associated with optimum population; Thompson with demographic transition theory, Notestein with its formal three-stage version and Ehrlich with The Population Bomb.

o: High birth and death rates caused by epidemics
Persistent population decline with fertility below 2.1 and an inverted age pyramid
Rapid population growth with a broad-based age pyramid
A temporary population fall after a famine
nc0adc5ab4ce.x: Demographic winter denotes persistent structural decline, generally with fertility below 2.1 and an inverted population pyramid.

nd51b58dd192.s: Southern States that successfully reduced fertility fear which outcome?
o: Higher tax devolution and more seats after delimitation
Higher tax devolution but fewer seats after delimitation
Lower tax devolution but more seats after delimitation
Lower tax devolution and fewer seats after delimitation
nd51b58dd192.x: Southern States that reduced fertility face concerns about lower tax devolution and fewer seats after delimitation.

nacdceac69c0.s:
Consider the following about Andhra Pradesh and demographic dividend:
1. The State combines a 9.21% growth rate with a large youth workforce.
2. Its literacy rate of 67.35% remains a concern.
3. Its dividend rests exclusively on a rising elderly population.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nacdceac69c0.x: AP pairs a 9.21% growth rate with a large youth workforce, but its 67.35% literacy lags; a dividend rests on the working-age, not elderly, population.

n0c95824a21c.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh is ageing faster than India.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh has a low TFR of 1.5 and a median age of 32.5 years.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0c95824a21c.x: Both are true; low fertility (TFR 1.5) and a relatively high median age (32.5) explain why AP is ageing faster than India.

ne3ab47db052.s: As per SRS 2024, the median age of India's population is about:
ne3ab47db052.x: SRS 2024 figures: 15–59 share 66.4%, children 0–14 at 24% and median age 28 years.

n313b732f980.s: Andhra Pradesh's Population Management Policy (February 2026) shifts the focus from population control towards:
o: Managing ageing and the demographic dividend
n313b732f980.x: The February 2026 policy shifts emphasis from population control to managing ageing and harnessing the demographic dividend.

n4ef7a563f40.s: Which of the following pairs (sex ratio, Census 2011) is correctly matched?
n4ef7a563f40.x: Puducherry recorded 1,037; Tamil Nadu 996, Lakshadweep 946 and undivided AP 993.

n7e4bd3c6438.s: As per the Civil Registration System (CRS) 2024, India's sex ratio at birth was:
n7e4bd3c6438.x: CRS 2024 recorded a sex ratio at birth of 917, and birth and death registration crossed 99% for the first time.

n32c8aaae5ed.s: India's overall sex ratio rose from 991 in NFHS-4 to ____ in NFHS-5.
n32c8aaae5ed.x: India's NFHS-5 sex ratio was 1,020 against 991 in NFHS-4; AP's NFHS-4 figure was also 1,020.

n0a3c9c8e1d5.s:
Consider the following (AP vs India):
1. Andhra Pradesh's sex ratio (997) is higher than India's (943).
2. Andhra Pradesh's child sex ratio is lower than India's.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n0a3c9c8e1d5.x: AP's child sex ratio (944) is higher than India's (918), so statement 2 is wrong; its sex ratio of 997 exceeds India's 943.

n91d82231162.s:
Consider the following about demographic conditions in British India:
1. Overall literacy was below 16%.
2. Female literacy was about 7%.
3. Infant mortality was about 32 per 1,000.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n91d82231162.x: Overall literacy was below 16% and female literacy about 7%; infant mortality was about 218 per 1,000 (life expectancy about 32 years), so 3 is wrong.

n74f31bc0416.s:
Consider the following about gender indicators in education:
1. Female GER in higher education rose to 30.2.
2. Female GER exceeded male GER.
3. Gender parity was reported at all school levels.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n74f31bc0416.x: All three are correct: female higher-education GER reached 30.2, exceeded male GER, and gender parity was reported at all school levels.

n3bc43ad1d82.s:
Consider the following about Census and PLFS literacy rates:
1. PLFS uses the same 7+ definition of literacy as the Census.
2. PLFS and Census rates are directly comparable because they use the same sample.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n3bc43ad1d82.x: PLFS uses the same 7+ definition but is a sample survey with different samples, so its rates are not directly comparable with the Census.

nb14f169c8d8.s: As per Census 2011, the female literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh was:
nb14f169c8d8.x: AP recorded total literacy of 67.35%, male 74.77% and female 59.96% in 2011.

n94e7bd6d7b8.s: Andhra Pradesh's target-oriented adult literacy drive covers which districts?
o: Districts with literacy above the State average
Districts below the State average in literacy
n94e7bd6d7b8.x: The target-oriented adult literacy drive covers districts whose literacy is below the State average.

nfcaeb21ef52.s: Saakshar Bharat, launched on International Literacy Day 2009, primarily targeted:
o: Adults aged 15+ years, with focus on women
Youth aged 15–29 years in urban areas
nfcaeb21ef52.x: Saakshar Bharat was launched on 8 September 2009 for adults aged 15 years and above, with special focus on women.

nf77fea20751.s: Which of the following NEP 2020 stage – age group pairs is correctly matched?
nf77fea20751.x: NEP 2020 stages: Foundational 3–8, Preparatory 8–11, Middle 11–14 and Secondary 14–18 years.

nbb7aabefbf2.s: For a Census Town, at least what share of male main workers must be in non-agricultural activities?
nbb7aabefbf2.x: A Census Town needs 5,000+ population, 75%+ of male main workers in non-agricultural work and density of at least 400 per sq km.

ncefd7f5229e.s: The U-curve of female labour force participation is associated with:
ncefd7f5229e.x: Claudia Goldin's U-curve says women's work participation first falls and then rises with development; India followed the declining half till 2018-19.

nfe06239c544.s: As per Census 2011, which category formed the largest share of India's workers?
nfe06239c544.x: Other workers formed 41.6% of workers, ahead of agricultural labourers (30.0%), cultivators (24.6%) and household industry workers (3.8%).

n69ef7432619.s: A fall in the unemployment rate may not signal better jobs because it may reflect:
n69ef7432619.x: A lower unemployment rate may reflect distress entry into low-productivity work rather than creation of decent, secure employment.

n4b158ed2cce.s: Which of the following has contributed to low female work participation in India?
o: Wide availability of flexible working hours
Mechanisation reducing demand for manual labour
n4b158ed2cce.x: Mechanisation, greater education of girls, lack of flexible hours, distance, safety concerns and family duties have lowered female work participation.

n44ddb7288b2.s: Which was cited as one reason for the higher female work participation rate in rural Andhra Pradesh?
n44ddb7288b2.x: MGNREGS was cited as one reason for the higher female work participation rate in rural areas.

n506b46c1802.s:
Consider the following:
1. Scheduled Tribes are more rural than Scheduled Castes.
2. About 89.97% of STs live in urban areas.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n506b46c1802.x: STs are even more rural than SCs; about 89.97% of the ST population lives in rural, not urban, areas.

nf753d9bcdee.s: Scheduled Castes are particularly concentrated in:
o: Fertile alluvial plains and coastal deltas
nf753d9bcdee.x: SCs are dense in fertile alluvial plains such as Punjab, the Ganga plain, West Bengal and coastal deltas, where settled farming used landless labour.

nd16b6519aaa.s: Which State has the highest share of Scheduled Tribes in its population?
nd16b6519aaa.x: Mizoram has the highest ST share among States (94.4%); Madhya Pradesh has the largest ST population, and Lakshadweep the highest overall share (94.8%).

nindian-geography-21-2.s: Which of the following about Census 2011 is INCORRECT?
o: Uttar Pradesh had the highest population.
Kerala had the highest literacy rate.
Arunachal Pradesh had the highest population density.
Bihar had the highest population density.
nindian-geography-21-2.x: Arunachal Pradesh had the lowest density (17 per sq km); Bihar had the highest (1,106).

n05fa05542ac.s: Gondi, the language of the Gonds, belongs to which language family?
n05fa05542ac.x: The Gonds are the second-largest tribe, and Gondi is a Dravidian language.

n0b424ea8ff5.s: Bastar Dussehra is associated with which State?
n0b424ea8ff5.x: Bastar Dussehra is associated with Chhattisgarh, whereas the Hornbill Festival belongs to Nagaland.

nf2dfb816b33.s: In Andhra Pradesh, tribal settlements are mainly concentrated in:
o: The Eastern Ghats, Godavari basin hill tracts and Nallamala belt
nf2dfb816b33.x: AP's tribal settlements are concentrated in the Eastern Ghats, north coastal hill tracts, Godavari basin and Nallamala belt, following forested uplands rather than deltas.

nindian-geography-9-1.s: Which of the following tribe – economy pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-9-1.x: The Jaunsari practise agriculture and polyandry; the Raji practised jhum, the Gond hunt and fish, and the Gaddi herd livestock seasonally.

nindian-geography-9-2.s: Which of the following about the Tharu is INCORRECT?
o: They are found in the Terai of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.
They are a pastoral tribe of the Dhauladhar Range.
They are found in Nainital, Uttarakhand.
They are found in Khatima and Sitarganj of Udham Singh Nagar.
nindian-geography-9-2.x: The Dhauladhar pastoralists are the Gaddi; the Tharu are a Terai people of UP, Bihar and Uttarakhand.

n0aed1ab88b9.s:
Arrange the following tribes in descending order of population:
A. Minas
B. Santhals
C. Bhils
D. Gonds
n0aed1ab88b9.x: The major-tribe ranking is Bhils, Gonds, Santhals, Minas (followed by Naikdas and Oraons).

nindian-geography-7-2.s: Which of the following tribe – location pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Tharu – Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
Gaddi – Himachal Pradesh and Jammu & Kashmir
nindian-geography-7-2.x: The Jaunsari live in Jaunsar-Bawar of Dehradun, Uttarakhand (formerly undivided UP), not Himachal Pradesh.

n0df1cceba27.s: Under Article 342(2), a community can be included in or excluded from the notified ST list only by:
o: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
n0df1cceba27.x: Article 342(2) provides that only Parliament may alter the notified ST list by law; the lists are specific to each State or UT.

nindian-geography-7-20.s: Which of the following tribe – State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-7-20.x: The Lepcha live in Sikkim; the Kharwar in Uttar Pradesh, the Garo in Meghalaya and the Bodo in Assam.

n0fc71994f33.s:
Assertion (A): The Bhil tribe is regarded as the largest Scheduled Tribe of India.
Reason (R): The Bhils number about 1.7 crore, roughly 16 per cent of India's ST population.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0fc71994f33.x: Both are true; the Bhils' population of about 1.7 crore (about 16% of STs) explains why they are the largest ST.

n3ad87126ddc.s: The Shompen, who voted for the first time in the April 2024 Lok Sabha election, inhabit:
n3ad87126ddc.x: The Shompen of Great Nicobar voted for the first time in April 2024 in the Andaman and Nicobar constituency; they are classified as Mongoloid.

na491e6a8459.s: Which of the following tribe – State/UT pairs is correctly matched?
na491e6a8459.x: Gaddis are shepherds of Himachal Pradesh; Jarawas live in the Andamans, Santhals mainly in Jharkhand and Bhutias in Sikkim.

nindian-geography-9-11.s: The Bakarwal community of Jammu and Kashmir is traditionally associated with:
nindian-geography-9-11.x: The Bakarwal herd goats and sheep, moving between high summer pastures and winter plains - seasonal pastoralism.

n71f865d5a73.s: Of India's 6,40,867 villages in 2011, how many were inhabited?
n71f865d5a73.x: India had 6,40,867 villages, of which 5,97,608 (about 93.2%) were inhabited.

n6a3d7c0553b.s: Which north-eastern State is an exception to the region's generally low level of urbanisation?
n6a3d7c0553b.x: Mizoram is the north-eastern exception, being relatively more urbanised than the regional pattern.

n5a5037f0e3d.s: The plains population of Andhra Pradesh is mainly associated with which racial element?
n5a5037f0e3d.x: AP's plains population is mainly Mediterranean and predominantly Dravidian-speaking.

nworld-geography-27-2.s: Which of the following descriptions of racial groups is INCORRECT?
o: Mongoloids – straight black hair, epicanthic folds, broad faces
Caucasoids – light to olive skin, straight or wavy hair, narrow noses
Mongoloids – light skin, wavy hair, narrow noses, tall stature
Negroids – dark skin, woolly hair, broad noses, thick lips
nworld-geography-27-2.x: Option 3 describes Caucasoid traits; Mongoloids have straight black hair and epicanthic folds.

nworld-geography-27-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-27-4.x: Pygmies live in the Congo Basin; Inuit in the Arctic, Native Americans in the Americas and Negritos in the Andamans and South-east Asia.

n2a60759cbe6.s:
Arrange the following communities in descending order of literacy rate (Census 2011):
A. Hindus
B. Jains
C. Muslims
D. Christians
n2a60759cbe6.x: The literacy ranking was Jain, Christian, Buddhist, Sikh, Hindu and Muslim, so B, D, A, C.

nindian-geography-21-8.s: As per Census 2011, India's sex ratio was:
nindian-geography-21-8.x: Census 2011 recorded a sex ratio of 943 females per 1,000 males and density of 382 per sq km.

nfb638cbd1d1.s: Dalits constitute about what share of Punjab's population?
nfb638cbd1d1.x: Dalits form about 32% of Punjab's population, which also has the largest concentration of Ravidassias.

ndac95ba715d.s: Christians form a majority of the population in which group of States?
ndac95ba715d.x: Christians are a majority in Nagaland, Mizoram and Meghalaya; in Arunachal Pradesh they are the largest group but only about 30%.

nb106ef687d1.s: In Arunachal Pradesh, Christians are the largest single religious group, forming about:
nb106ef687d1.x: Christians are the largest single group in Arunachal Pradesh but form only about 30%, so they are not a majority.

n98b13906b3d.s: In which State has a Uniform Civil Code been in force since January 2025?
n98b13906b3d.x: Uttarakhand's UCC came into force in January 2025; Bills of Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh were awaiting Presidential assent.

naaef70cecf1.s: Which State enacted an anti-conversion law in 1967, followed by Madhya Pradesh in 1968?
naaef70cecf1.x: Odisha enacted an anti-conversion law in 1967 and Madhya Pradesh in 1968; they were the first such States.

n2e8571989fb.s: The Christian population of Andhra Pradesh is concentrated mainly in:
o: The coastal districts and tribal agency areas
n2e8571989fb.x: AP's Christian population is concentrated in the coastal districts and tribal agency areas, not Rayalaseema or a single city.

na75a53f6c82.s: Gor Boli (Lambadi), spoken by the Banjaras, belongs to which language family?
na75a53f6c82.x: Gor Boli or Lambadi is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by Banjaras across several States and has no script of its own.

nworld-geography-28-2.s: Which of the following about language families is INCORRECT?
o: Sino-Tibetan spreads across China, Tibet, Myanmar and the Himalayas.
Austronesian spreads across South-East Asia, the Pacific Islands and Madagascar.
Dravidian languages are mainly found in North India.
Niger-Congo has the largest number of languages.
nworld-geography-28-2.x: Dravidian languages are mainly in South India, not North India; the other statements are correct.

nworld-geography-29-9.s: Which of the following language – family pairs is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-29-9.x: Bodo is Tibeto-Burman; Santali is Austro-Asiatic, Telugu Dravidian and Marathi Indo-Aryan.

n6ea4ab10149.s: In Census 2011, which language overtook Telugu for third place among India's languages?
n6ea4ab10149.x: Telugu was third in 2001, but Marathi overtook it in 2011, pushing Telugu to fourth.

n188f44cad12.s: The Ladakh Official Languages Regulation, 2025 lists which languages?
o: English, Urdu, Bhoti and Purgi only
English, Hindi, Urdu, Bhoti and Purgi
n188f44cad12.x: The Ladakh Official Languages Regulation, 2025 lists English, Hindi, Urdu, Bhoti and Purgi.

n59ef85e342f.s: Ol Chiki, the script of Santhali, was created in 1925 by:
n59ef85e342f.x: Raghunath Murmu created Ol Chiki in 1925; Santhali entered the Eighth Schedule through the 92nd Amendment, 2003.

nworld-geography-28-4.s: Which of the following language – family pairs is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-28-4.x: Swahili is Niger-Congo; English is Indo-European, Mandarin Sino-Tibetan and Tamil Dravidian.

nd84340cb65b.s: Which of the following basis – classification of migration pairs is correctly matched?
o: Number – Economic, social, political or religious
nd84340cb65b.x: By will, migration is voluntary or forced; by distance short or long, by number individual or mass, and by cause economic, social, political or religious.

na4a57c4c3b8.s: Rural-to-urban migration in India is dominated by:
na4a57c4c3b8.x: Rural-to-urban migration is dominated by males moving for employment and is a key force driving urbanisation.

n464a2b257c6.s: India's record remittances of US$135 billion in FY 2024–25 increasingly came from:
n464a2b257c6.x: Remittances in FY 2024–25 came increasingly from skilled professionals in developed countries rather than mainly from West Asia.

n63f4e911406.s: Seasonal labour migration from Andhra Pradesh is mainly from:
o: The urban districts of coastal Andhra
n63f4e911406.x: Seasonal labour leaves drought-prone Rayalaseema and the north-coastal districts of Andhra Pradesh.

o: Return of migrants to source areas
Transfer of skills and ideas by migrants
n61b6acd891c.x: Social remittances are the transfer of skills, knowledge and ideas by migrants, distinct from monetary remittances.

ne07c378e083.s: In 2024, India was the top remittance recipient and the only country above US$100 billion, receiving about:
ne07c378e083.x: India received US$137 billion in 2024, the only country to receive more than US$100 billion.
